entities.summary: Brigitte Margret Ida Mohnhaupt is a German convicted former terrorist associated with the second generation of the Red Army Faction (RAF) members. She was also part of the Socialist Patients' Collective (SPK). Brigitte Mohnhaupt was a journalists & chroniclers from Rheinberg (b. 1949-06-24, Rheinberg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
